Local Boost Lab — GBP management for local businesses

Every week, good businesses lose customers they would have won in a fair fight. The reason isn't price, or quality, or how their team shows up. It's Google. Specifically: a profile that looks like nobody's home. No recent posts. Unanswered reviews. The kind of digital storefront that says "we mean to fix this."
The fix isn't complicated. It just takes consistency, and consistency takes time that local business owners genuinely don't have. That's where we come in.

Local Boost Lab handles your Google Business Profile completely: review responses in your voice, posts on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday every week, and a clean monthly report on the 5th. No agency markup. No contracts. No dashboards you have to learn, use, or pretend you're using.
from signup to first post live

We handle the work that's important enough to matter but tedious enough that nobody ever actually does it: responding to reviews before they go cold, posting on a consistent schedule, and tracking how your profile is performing month over month.

A few things we want to be upfront about: we never auto-respond to negative reviews (that would be a disaster and we both know it), we don't guarantee search rankings (nobody honest does), and we don't lock you in. If it's not working for you, you leave. No invoice. No hard feelings.

We follow Google's guidelines, write content in your voice rather than ours, and send a monthly report you can actually read in two minutes. You'll always know what's happening without logging into anything.

For years, Juan built marketing departments for U.S. companies. He watched business owners hire agencies, sign 12-month contracts, and wait 3–4 weeks for basic deliverables. Google Business Profiles sat neglected. Reviews went unanswered. Leads died on the vine.
Then he'd ask: "Why aren't you managing this yourself?" The answer was always the same: "Too much to keep up with. We need someone dedicated, but can't afford $1,500/month."

Juan realized the real problem wasn't the service — it was the pricing model. Agencies charge a premium because they hire account managers, run meetings, and waste time on admin overhead. What if you stripped all that away and delivered the same results for the cost of a single coffee meeting? That's Local Boost Lab.
